audience: Decodex operators auditing the X Publisher automation
text: Decodex publisher media live test (2026-06-02): verifying generated signal-card upload, @decodexspace publication, final URL readback, and Chrome tab cleanup. This post may be deleted after validation.
evidence_notes: Chrome tab-control recovered: a new about:blank tab was created, read back, and finalized before the X media test.
The X account switcher was used to select Decodex @decodexspace, and the page body confirmed Decodex @decodexspace before composing.
The generated Decodex signal-card PNG was uploaded through the X file chooser; setFiles returned successfully and X displayed AI generated content detected / Made with AI before publication.
The post was submitted from the @decodexspace composer, then read back from the timeline with a status permalink and photo link.
The permalink page independently verified the post text, @decodexspace account, Made with AI label, /photo/1 link, and image nodes.
Chrome tab cleanup returned successfully, and a fresh read-only tab listing found no residual media permalink tab after cleanup.

claims.text: The @decodexspace Chrome Publisher path can verify account state, upload generated media, submit a post, read back the final X permalink, and confirm the media photo link.
The generated media used for the live test is persisted in the Decodex repository artifact tree.
Chrome scoped tab cleanup completed after the media publication readback.

decision.reason: Operator explicitly authorized a controlled media-attached live X publication test to verify the automated Publisher path end to end.

caveats: X displayed an Unlock more on X account notice after submit; the post permalink and media readback are valid, but account reach or trust limits may be platform-gated.
The test post is intentionally public and may be deleted by the operator after validation.
